title: Lifespan Bounds and Super-Classical Propagation for Weak Solutions of the Three-Dimensional Compressible Euler Equations
summary: We establish an upper bound on the lifespan of bounded weak solutions to the three-dimensional isentropic compressible Euler equations on $[0,T)\times\mathbb R^3$, under a localized positivity condition on the initial data and the assumption that the essential support of the disturbance propagates into an undisturbed background state no faster than predicted by classical local well-posedness.
